closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, slots into meals very easily, and easy to fit into familiar meals, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It's good for practical meals, bone health, and blood and oxygen support because it's easy to build meals around, vitamin D can support bones, and vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
